page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance consistently in the average tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1439.19 and a multi-core score of 15350.78, supported by AVX-512 instruction sets. Memory bandwidth is measured at 855.0 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 90.64 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. In application-specific tests, the server achieves 15.39 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and a static web serving throughput of 12.4 GB/sec. For machine learning workloads, prompt processing on a small 135M LLM model reaches 942.59 tokens per second, though performance drops to a weak 23.22 tokens per second when processing prompts on a medium 7B model.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio, the ecs.hfg6.4xlarge offers a stable resource profile for production environments. The lack of bundled local storage requires external block storage, which should be factored into deployment architectures. This server is suited for general-purpose workloads, web serving, database operations, software compilation, and lightweight text or image processing tasks that benefit from dedicated x86_64 compute resources without requiring GPU acceleration.
